actions.action: Check soil moisture 5 cm deep every 3–4 days
If soil is dry, water thoroughly and empty basket/saucer after 15 minutes
Move both plants to brightest window, at least 1 m from radiator
Check base of each stem weekly for softness, browning or sour smell
If rot signs appear, post an update

reason: The answer correctly identifies transplant shock but blames dry air instead of the cold window, and its advice to move the plants to the brightest window never warns about cold glass, so it only partly matches the fix; nothing in it is likely to cause harm.
